   effective working point of the end-effector with respect to the robot flange.

   repeatability during pick-and-drop operations.

citations.evidenceText:
Calibration Procedure :

•  Step 1: Select the desired tool number in the Tool/Base calibration menu.
•  Step 2: Choose a fixed reference point on the worktable or calibration pin.
•  Step 3: Move the tool tip to the reference point and record the first position.
•  Step 4: Change the robot orientation while keeping the tool tip on the same
   point and record the second position.
•  Step 5: Repeat the process for the third orientation.
•  Step 6: Record a fourth pose with a different orientation.
•  Step 7: KUKA System Software automatically calculates
   the TCP coordinates (X, Y, Z) relative to the robot flange.
•  Step 8: Verify the calibration by performing linear
   motions and checking for positional deviations.

Coordinate Transformation :

•  Coordinate transformation is the process of converting object positions
   obtained from the camera coordinate system into the robot coordinate system.

   obtained in the robot base frame, which are used for

•  Detection uses classical OpenCV image processing.
•  No deep learning or trained models involved.
•  HSV(Hue, Saturation, Value) colour space chosen
   over RGB since it separates hue from lighting-
   dependent intensity, giving robustness to uneven
